For the Faithful Departed/Holy Souls: The final November Divine Mercy Devotion & Rosary will be held in Maghera Church at 3pm today Sunday 22nd November. Advent: Next weekend we begin a four-week preparation for the feast of Advent. The season of A dvent gives us the opportunity to prepare spiritually for the season of Christmas. First Sunday of Advent: The blessing of the advent wreath at all Masses. Second Sunday of Advent: Senior Citizen's Christmas gathering. Third Sunday of Advent: Bambenelli Sunday. All are invited to bring the baby Jesus from your crib to Mass on the weekend of 12th/13th December for a special blessing on your family home this Christ mas. Also, Sacramental Masses for those preparing for first Holy Communion and Confirmation . Abbey Pastoral Area Advent Reconciliation Service: Monday 14th December 7.30pm Cathedral of SS Peter & Paul’s Ennis. Come and experience the freedom that comes with knowing that we are for given. The Messenger: For many, many years, this pocket-sized magazine has been at the heart of Catholic Church life in Ireland. Published by the Jesuit order, this little gemhas, down the years, provided reassurance for our parents and grandparents in the beliefs and practices of their Catholic faith. We encourage families t hroughout the parish to re- engage with the Messenger. A years subscription costs only €30 and the magazine is del ivered each month. For further details, contact Joe Quinlivan, Quin. Tel 065/6825643. Census 2027: Ireland’s next census will take place between 5 April and 9 May next year. To help us carry it out we are recruiting 3,850 Census Field Support Officers all over the country. This competition will open on Monday, 23 November and applications will be accepted online at census.ie . The competition is due to close on Friday, 4 December at 2pm. However, we are advising people to apply early as if we r each 12,000 applications before this, the completion will close earlier than this date. The jobs are temporary eight-week contracts from 5 April to 28 May 2027 and are part- time, 18 hours per week. Over €3000 plus an allowance can be earned for the duration of the contract. These are unique and rewarding jobs and a chance to be part of census history with the first online census in 2027. Successful applicants will work within their local areas. Quin Village Tidy Towns AGM: Following a fantastic year, Quin Village Tidy Towns will hold its AGM on Tuesday, 24th November, at 8pm in the Abbey Room, Quin Community Hall. We have much to celebrate, including our Gold Medal, Clare County Winner title and Best Newcomer in the All-Ireland Pollinator Plan Local Authority Pollinator Awards. The Return to Nature Clare Church Biodiversity Project at St Mary’s Church played an important role in these achievements, particularly our national Pollinator Award. Sincere thanks to Fr Tom for his continued support and to everyone involved in this project and our many other i nitiatives. We look forward to building on these successes. Everyone is welcome to our AGM to share ideas and plan for the year ahead. New volunteers are especially welcome! Let’s keep Quin blooming! Quin Taekwondo Split The Pot: Congratulations to this week's Split the Pot winner, Louise McCormack who won €85. The next draw takes place on Tuesday, November 24th. Envelopes for the Split the Pot can be filled in at Gala, The Village Inn, Abbey Express, The Post Office, The Monks Well, The Taste of Quin and The Abbey Tavern. Lotto Draw 19th November 2026: Jackpot: €20,000. Numbers drawn: 4,22,31,32. No winner. €40 winners: Enda Garvey; Denis Quinn; Damien McCarthy; Joe Littleton Tulla; M. Halpin Toonagh, Tulla . Next draw Clubhouse 26th November 2026. Jackpot: €20,000. Tickets available online

- purchase cut-off time 5.00pm. Also available in Gala, Quin Post Office, and Clooney Stores - purchase cut-off time 1.00pm. We thank you for your continued support. Go raibh maith agaibh as bhur dtacaíocht leanúnach Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat | 11th-13th December 2026: Calling all young people aged 16 –35! Join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. This is a donation-only event, with free buses available across the country and all meals included. Expect inspiring talks and workshops, Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to chill out and meet other young Catholics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. To register or find out more, visit
or follow @Youth2000Ireland Thought for the Week: Do what you can do, and, if you pray, God will do what you can’t do.

INIS CEALTRA PASTORAL AREA SCARIFF PARISH NEWSLETTER These are now available from the Church. A Tridium of Masses will be offered during the Christmas Season. Just €3 and all proceeds will go to the Parish Renovation Fund. First Reconciliation and Holy Communion: Sunday 22nd November at 11am Prayer Rituals – Sunday 20th December at 11am for Holy Communion & Confirmation This Sunday is known as “Christ the King” , it is the last Sunday of the Church Liturgical Year. On next Sunday 29th November we will celebrate the First Sunday of Advent, when we begin the churches Liturgical New Year. We will begin once more our preparation for the birth of Jesus.
